extracted.intended_audience: corporate sustainability teams, business leaders, and financial institutions seeking to set or validate greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions reduction targets
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for companies and financial institutions to set, implement and validate greenhouse gas emissions reduction targets that are aligned with climate science and net-zero objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science-based emissions reduction targets
rubrics_metrics.description: Set greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions reductions targets in line with what is needed to keep global heating below catastrophic levels and reach net-zero by 2050 at latest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SBTi standards, tools and guidance to define targets that are grounded in climate science. Explore 'How to set science-based targets' and SBTi's published standards to ensure targets reflect the scale of reductions required by science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Net-zero by 2050 ambition
rubrics_metrics.description: Targets should be consistent with reaching net-zero by 2050 at the latest; net-zero ambition is a core objective of SBTi-aligned target-setting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When designing targets and strategies, ensure they contribute to an overall trajectory that achieves net-zero emissions by 2050. SBTi updates (e.g., to methodologies like the ACA) are intended to maintain this net-zero ambition while improving implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validation of targets by SBTi
rubrics_metrics.description: Companies can seek SBTi validation so their targets are considered 'validated science-based targets' by the initiative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Validated targets are tracked and counted by SBTi (the page cites numbers of companies with validated targets). Follow SBTi submission and validation processes and the applicable standards to achieve validation and public recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of approved methodologies (e.g., Absolute Contraction Approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply SBTi-approved methodological approaches—such as the Absolute Contraction Approach (ACA)—to ensure consistency, credibility and alignment with net-zero ambition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor and adopt updates to methodologies: the SBTi 'updates the Absolute Contraction Approach to improve consistency and implementation, while maintaining net-zero ambition.' Use the current, SBTi-updated methods for calculations and target-setting to meet requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sector- and scope-specific guidance (e.g., FLAG Guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow sector- and topic-specific guidance where relevant—such as the Forest, Land and Agriculture (FLAG) Guidance—to set appropriate science-based targets for particular activities or sectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SBTi issues and updates targeted guidance to strengthen clarity and consistency for companies (the page notes an updated FLAG Guidance). Use the relevant guidance for your sector (e.g., FLAG for land-related emissions) to ensure targets address sector-specific issues and methodological requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrable business benefits as evidence of impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Validated science-based targets are associated with measurable business benefits—SBTi reporting cites outcomes such as improved reputation, investor confidence, strategic cohesion and accelerated decarbonization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SBTi's report (cited figures: e.g., 91% saw positive overall impact; 76% increased investor confidence; 95% enhanced reputation; 80% improved strategic cohesion; 86% accelerated decarbonization) can be used to evaluate and communicate the business value of adopting validated targets. Use these outcome metrics when assessing or promoting target adoption internally or externally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adopt SBTi standards, tools and guidance as the authoritative framework
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the Science Based Targets initiative's standards, tools and guidance as the basis for setting and implementing corporate climate targets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The SBTi provides the normative framework for ambition, methods and validation—companies and financial institutions should rely on the SBTi's published standards, trackers, and guidance documents to design credible targets and to stay current with methodological updates and reporting expectations.
